document: The Slim Margin between Love & Hate: Voter motivation, regional battles reveal emerging B.C. campaign picture (Angus Reid Institute, 2024-10-14)
note: Final ARI poll before the 2024-10-19 election. Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=2,863. Shares among decided, leaning and already-voted respondents from the tables (2024.10.14_BC_Post_Debate_tables.pdf, QVBC1/QVBC2/QM2). n = decided bases printed in the table. AUTRES = 'Other party/Independent candidate' total, which includes BC United (withdrawn; 0-1%), independents and Freedom Party. ARI uses six regions here; Metro Vancouver is split into three, so new codes: VANCOUVER-BURNABY ('City of Vancouver/ Burnaby'), RICHMOND-SURREY ('Richmond/ Surrey'), MAPLE-RIDGE-LANGLEY-COQUITLAM ('Maple Ridge/ Pitt Meadows/ Langley/ Coquitlam'), plus VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST ('Island/North Coast').

MAPLE-RIDGE-LANGLEY-COQUITLAM.libelle: Maple Ridge/ Pitt Meadows/ Langley/ Coquitlam
